name: IC Isolator — I2C — SOIC
description: Surface-mount I2C isolator IC cluster containing 5 KiCad symbol parts in SOIC-8 and SOIC-16W package footprint options.
selection_hints: Select SOIC-8 footprint (SOIC-8_3.9x4.9mm_P1.27mm) for ISO1540 or ISO1541 parts.
Select SOIC-16W footprint (SOIC-16W_7.5x10.3mm_P1.27mm) for ISO1642DWR, ISO1643DWR, or ISO1644DWR parts.
Choose between SOIC-8 and SOIC-16W packages based on the required component footprint.
avoid_when: Through-hole mounting is required instead of SMD.
Package footprints other than SOIC-8 or SOIC-16W are required.
Isolators for non-I2C interfaces are needed.
